meta.title: dsh-typst
meta.description: Typst plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a live preview right-sidebar panel driven by the user's own typst, with agent tools that check errors, look at rendered pages, point at places in the preview, and export PDFs.

typstPathHint: Optional. Full path of the typst executable. By default it is looked up on PATH and in common install locations; set it only when Typst is installed elsewhere.
